card.name: Inside journal and reference titles
card.fires_on: The word just before or inside a proper title of a journal, textbook or grading scale in a citation, such as 'the' before a journal name or 'Common' in National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria.

modes.label: Journal issue citations
modes.description: 'the' after 'issue of' just before a journal name.
modes.example: The study and editorial appear in the June 21 issue of<< the>> Annals of Internal Medicine.

modes.label: NCI grading scale name
modes.description: 'Common' after National Cancer Institute, starting Common Terminology Criteria.
modes.example: *Graded per National Cancer Institute<< Common>> Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events.

modes.label: Reference list names
modes.description: Start of an author, book or journal abbreviation in a reference entry.
modes.example: Ferri, Fred, ed.<< Fer>>ri’s Clinical Advisor

card.writes: It pushes toward the next piece of a proper name and away from words starting with 'supp'.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of citations and titles, right before the name of a journal, book or scale is completed.
